content.title: Joint Training Deep Boltzmann Machines for Classification
content.abstract: We introduce a new method for training deep Boltzmann machines jointly. Prior methods require an initial learning pass that trains the deep Boltzmann machine greedily, one layer at a time, or do not perform well on classification tasks. In our approach, we train all layers of the DBM simultaneously, using a novel inpainting-based objective function that facilitates second order optimization and line searches.
